name: Duplicati
description: Sauvegardez vos données vers le cloud ou un disque, chiffrées.
compose:
services:
  duplicati:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/duplicati:latest
    container_name: duplicati
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      - PUID={{PUID}}
      - PGID={{PGID}}
      - TZ={{TZ}}
      - SETTINGS_ENCRYPTION_KEY=azmoos-change-me
    ports:
      - "8200:8200"
    volumes:
      - {{APPDATA}}/config:/config
      - {{DATA}}:/source
      - {{DATA}}/Backups:/backups

en.description: Back up your data to the cloud or a disk, encrypted.
